cards.ex: She's very fashion-conscious and always knows the latest trends.
cards.exUz: U juda uslubga e'tiborli va har doim eng so'nggi trendlarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Uslublar va moda haqida qayg'uradigan, doimo zamonaviy ko'rinishga harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: She dressed to kill for her first date.
cards.exUz: U birinchi sanasida diqqatni tortish uchun hashamatli kiyindi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni tortish va hayratlantirish uchun hashamatli va jozibali kiyinish.

cards.ex: His designs are always on the cutting edge of fashion.
cards.exUz: Uning dizaynlari har doim moda sohasining eng oldingi qatorida.
cards.uzDef: Eng zamonaviy va innovatsion uslublar va dizaynlardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: She looked a million dollars in that red dress.
cards.exUz: U qizil ko'ylakda million dollarga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli, hashamatli va muvaffaqiyatli ko'rinish.

cards.ex: I just threw on a jacket before leaving the house.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki uydan chiqishdan oldin jaket kiyib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Tez va e'tiborsiz ravishda biror narsani kiyib olish.

cards.ex: Wearing jeans to the wedding was a definite dress code violation.
cards.exUz: To'yga jinsi kiyim kiyish kiyim qoidasini aniq buzish edi.
cards.uzDef: Muassasa yoki tadbirda qabul qilingan kiyim qoidalariga rioya qilmaslik.

cards.ex: She always goes for a classic look with simple dresses and pearl necklaces.
cards.exUz: U har doim oddiy ko'ylaklar va marvarid marjonlar bilan klassik ko'rinishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Modadan tashqari, har doim dolzarb va oqlangan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: They were dressed to the nines for the opera.
cards.exUz: Ular opera uchun eng zo'r kiyingan edilar.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi, hashamatli va murakkab kiyimlarda kiyingan.

cards.ex: Wearing socks with sandals is considered a major fashion faux pas.
cards.exUz: Sandal bilan paypoq kiyish katta moda xatosi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Moda sohasida nomaqbul yoki xato deb hisoblangan kiyim tanlash.

cards.ex: She always looks so put together, even in casual clothes.
cards.exUz: U hatto kundalik kiyimlarda ham doim yaxshi kiyingan ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Uslubli va yaxshi muvofiqlashtirilgan kiyimlarda ko'rinish.

cards.ex: Audrey Hepburn is considered a timeless fashion icon.
cards.exUz: Audrey Hepburn abadiy moda ikoni hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Uslubi va ta'siri bilan tanilgan va hurmatga sazovor shaxs.

cards.ex: The dress rehearsal is tomorrow night before the opening performance.
cards.exUz: Libosdagi mashq ertaga oqshom, ochilish spektakli oldidan.
cards.uzDef: Spektakl yoki tadbir oldidan barcha kiyimlar bilan o'tkaziladigan yakuniy mashq.

cards.ex: He's been working in the rag trade for over 20 years.
cards.exUz: U 20 yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri kiyim savdosida ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim ishlab chiqarish va sotish bilan shug'ullanuvchi sanoat.

cards.ex: You should dress for the occasion; it's a formal dinner.
cards.exUz: Siz vaziyatga mos kiyinishingiz kerak; bu rasmiy kechki ovqat.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir tadbir yoki vaziyatga mos keladigan kiyimlarni tanlash.

cards.ex: She loves shopping for vintage clothing in thrift stores.
cards.exUz: U tejamkorlik do'konlarida vintage kiyimlar xarid qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi modaga tegishli bo'lgan, kamida 20 yoshdan oshgan kiyimlar.

cards.ex: Bell-bottom jeans are all the rage again.
cards.exUz: Qo'ng'iroq shaklidagi jinsilar yana eng so'nggi moda.
cards.uzDef: Ayni paytda juda mashhur va ommabop bo'lgan moda yo'nalishi yoki element.

cards.ex: I wouldn't be caught dead wearing that outfit.
cards.exUz: Men hech qachon bunday kiyimda ko'rinmasdim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon qilmaysiz yoki kiymaysiz degan ma'noni anglatadi.

cards.ex: You can find affordable high street fashion in most cities.
cards.exUz: Aksariyat shaharlarda arzon ommaviy modani topishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy do'konlarda sotiladigan, arzon va so'nggi moda tendensiyalarini aks ettiruvchi kiyimlar.

cards.ex: She only wears designer labels; she's very brand conscious.
cards.exUz: U faqat dizayner yorlig'i ostidagi kiyimlarni kiyadi; u juda brendga e'tiborli.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur dizayner yoki moda uyining nomi yozilgan kiyimlar.

cards.ex: Her style is all about understated elegance; she prefers simple, well-made pieces.
cards.exUz: Uning uslubi nazokatli oddiylik haqida; u oddiy, yaxshi ishlangan buyumlarni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, ammo oqlangan va hashamatli ko'rinish, ortiqcha bezaksiz.

cards.ex: Chanel is a famous French fashion house.
cards.exUz: Chanel - mashhur frantsuz moda uyi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim va aksessuarlar dizayni va ishlab chiqarishi bilan shug'ullanuvchi kompaniya.

cards.ex: This suit is hand-tailored, which is why it fits so perfectly.
cards.exUz: Bu kostyum qo'lda tikilganligi sababli, u juda yaxshi turadi.
cards.uzDef: Mashinada emas, balki qo'lda tikilgan kiyim.

cards.ex: She has a great dress sense; she always knows what looks good on her.
cards.exUz: U kiyim tanlashning ajoyib hissiga ega; u har doim unga nima mos kelishini biladi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimlarni uslubli va mos tarzda tanlash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Her stunning dress made her turn heads wherever she went.
cards.exUz: Uning hayratlanarli libosi uni qayerga bormasin, odamlarning e'tiborini tortdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining tashqi ko'rinishi bilan odamlarning e'tiborini tortish.

cards.ex: She's such a slave to fashion; she buys everything she sees in magazines.
cards.exUz: U shunday moda quliki; u jurnallarda ko'rgan hamma narsani sotib oladi.
cards.uzDef: So'zsiz ravishda har bir moda tendensiyasiga ergashish, o'z uslubiga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: You can change any outfit by how you accessorize cleverly.
cards.exUz: Siz istalgan kiyimni aksessuarlarni qanchalik aqlli ishlatishingiz bilan o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimga mos va uslubni to'ldiruvchi aksessuarlardan mohirona foydalanish.

cards.ex: Coco Chanel created a timeless style that is still popular today.
cards.exUz: Coco Chanel bugungi kunda ham mashhur bo'lgan abadiy uslubni yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Modadan tashqari, har doim dolzarb va oqlangan bo'lib qoladigan uslub.

cards.ex: She focuses on elevated basics, so her wardrobe is versatile and stylish.
cards.exUz: U yuqori sifatli asoslarga e'tibor qaratadi, shuning uchun uning garderobi ko'p qirrali va zamonaviy.
cards.uzDef: Sifatli materiallardan tikilgan va yaxshi bichilgan oddiy kiyimlar.

cards.ex: The fashion cycle is getting shorter and shorter with social media.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar bilan moda davri tobora qisqarayapti.
cards.uzDef: Modaning paydo bo'lishi, mashhurligi va eskirishi davri.

cards.ex: I usually buy off-the-peg suits because they're more affordable.
cards.exUz: Men odatda tayyor kostyumlarni sotib olaman, chunki ular arzonroq.
cards.uzDef: Do'kondan tayyor holda sotib olinadigan, individual o'lchamlarga moslashtirilmagan kiyim.
